integrity: All formulae and finite exact checks are reproducible with embedded checker. Scholarly sources are credited; no independent certification or external priority guarantee is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Does not settle primitive distance-regular graphs of other families or Johnson graphs on larger subsets, nor the complete average-mixing spectrum. General Johnson adjacency-algebra eigenvalue computation was published in 2017; hidden stronger positivity implications remain a priority risk. Symbolic proof is separate from finite exact checks; no independent review undertaken.
scientific_scope: Unweighted adjacency-Hamiltonian conventional infinite-time quantum average mixing on J(n,3), all integers n>=6. A sharp full-rank threshold at n=7 and positive-definite lowest spectral projector square, with n=6 rank 10.
title: A sharp full-rank transition for average mixing on Johnson triple graphs
